Courts & playing surfaces

Designed around the sport.
Installed around the site.

Every facility begins with use case, ground conditions, drainage, surface specification and long-term maintenance requirements.

01

Padel & tennis

Complete court systems

Imported court structures, glass and fencing systems, artificial playing surfaces, nets, lighting and accessories—coordinated through installation and handover.

  • Padel court supply & installation
  • Tennis court surfacing and equipment
  • Lighting, enclosure and accessories
  • Inspection, maintenance and repairs
02

Football & multi-sport turf

Performance surfaces

Artificial turf systems for football and other sports, supported by basework, drainage, installation planning and maintenance coordination.

Where FIFA certification is required, the selected system and final installed field must follow the FIFA Quality Programme and pass testing by a FIFA-accredited field-test institute.

03

Athletics

Acrylic running tracks

Surface-system sourcing and installation coordination for running and training tracks, with attention to substrate preparation, drainage, line geometry, finish and lifecycle care.

  • Surface-system selection
  • Base and drainage coordination
  • Application and line marking
  • Maintenance planning

Smart scoreboards

One clear view of the game.

VTI supplies and supports digital scoreboard systems for cricket, football, padel, tennis and other sports. Project scope can include display selection, control systems, structural coordination, installation, testing and user orientation.
